capabilities: Restyle the Claudian chat with adjustable accent color, fonts, text sizes and backgrounds
Make chat tables and wide content scroll or wrap inside the message panel
Name and manage Claudian tabs after their linked notes
Add an Open in Claudian item to file and folder context menus
Open tool, thinking and subagent blocks by default in the newest reply
disambiguation: Not a version of the Minimal theme and not made by its author; it restyles the Claudian plugin's chat interface.
extras: Desktop only, like Claudian. Works by wrapping Claudian's internal CSS classes, tab manager and tab bar, so a Claudian update can break parts of it; COMPATIBILITY.md lists checked Claudian versions. Makes no network requests and collects no telemetry. Requires Obsidian 1.13 or later; tested with Claudian 2.3.35 on Obsidian 1.14.5.
intentEvidence: A quieter, minimal look for Claudian, the Obsidian plugin that brings Claude Code and other coding agents into your vault.
problem: Claudian's chat UI is visually busy, wide tables and long content overflow the panel, tabs show numbers instead of note names, and linking chats to files or folders is limited to the welcome screen.

relations.evidence: It needs Claudian installed and enabled; without Claudian it loads but changes nothing.

summary: Companion plugin that gives the Claudian AI-chat plugin a quieter minimal look and adds tab naming, context-menu and layout conveniences.
